name: sysinternals
description: Microsoft Sysinternals suite of system utilities for Windows administration and troubleshooting

accesschk64.description: Display access permissions for files, registry keys, and Windows services
accesschk64.usage:
accesschk64 -s /path # Show access for path
accesschk64 -q -u user service # Check service access
accesschk64 -w /path # Show write access

adrestore64.description: Restore deleted Active Directory objects from tombstone state
adrestore64.usage:
adrestore64 -r "CN=DeletedUser,CN=Deleted Objects,DC=domain,DC=com" # Restore deleted user
adrestore64 -l # List deleted objects

autorunsc64.description: Command-line version of Autoruns showing programs configured to run during startup
autorunsc64.usage:
autorunsc64 -a # Show all autorun entries
autorunsc64 -m # Show only Microsoft entries
autorunsc64 -c # CSV output format

clockres64.description: Display system clock resolution and timer information for performance analysis
clockres64.usage:
clockres64 # Show clock resolution
clockres64 -c # Continuous monitoring
clockres64 -h # High precision mode

contig64.description: Defragment individual files or analyze file fragmentation on NTFS volumes
contig64.usage:
Contig64 -a file.txt # Analyze fragmentation
Contig64 -f file.txt # Defragment file
Contig64 -s /path # Show fragmentation stats

coreinfo64.description: Display CPU and memory topology information including cores, threads, cache hierarchy, and NUMA nodes
coreinfo64.usage:
Coreinfo64 # Show CPU topology
Coreinfo64 -c # Logical to physical core mapping
Coreinfo64 -g # Group assignments
Coreinfo64 -n # NUMA node topology

findlinks64.description: Find all hard links to a file and display file link information on NTFS volumes
findlinks64.usage:
FindLinks64 file.txt # Find all hard links to file
FindLinks64 -v /path # Verbose output for path
FindLinks64 -r /dir # Recursive search in directory

handle64.description: Display open handles for processes, helping identify file and resource locks
handle64.usage:
handle64 # Show all handles
handle64 file.txt # Show handles to specific file
handle64 -p 1234 # Show handles for process ID
handle64 -u # Show unnamed handles

hex2dec64.description: Convert hexadecimal numbers to decimal and vice versa with support for various number bases
hex2dec64.usage:
hex2dec64 0x1A # Convert hex to decimal
hex2dec64 -d 26 # Convert decimal to hex
hex2dec64 -b 8 77 # Convert octal to decimal

junction64.description: Create, delete, and list NTFS junction points and symbolic links on Windows
junction64.usage:
junction64 link target # Create junction point
junction64 -d link # Delete junction
junction64 -s # Show existing junctions
junction64 link # Show junction target

listdlls64.description: Display loaded DLLs for running processes with version information and base addresses
listdlls64.usage:
listdlls64 # List DLLs for all processes
listdlls64 -p 1234 # List DLLs for specific PID
listdlls64 -v # Verbose version information
listdlls64 explorer # List DLLs for process name

logonsessions64.description: Display active logon sessions and associated processes on the local system
logonsessions64.usage:
LogonSessions64 # Show all logon sessions
LogonSessions64 -p # Include process information
LogonSessions64 -c # Show session creation time
LogonSessions64 -s # Summary format

pendmoves64.description: Display files and directories scheduled for move or delete on next reboot
pendmoves64.usage:
PendMoves64 # Show pending moves and deletes
PendMoves64 -c # Clear pending operations
PendMoves64 -v # Verbose output with full paths

pipelist64.description: Display named pipes on the system and processes that have them open
pipelist64.usage:
pipelist64 # List all named pipes
pipelist64 -v # Verbose pipe information
pipelist64 pipe_name # Show specific pipe details

procdump64.description: Generate dumps of running processes for analysis and troubleshooting
procdump64.usage:
procdump64 -ma process.exe # Full memory dump
procdump64 -e 1 -f C00000FD process.exe # Dump on exception
procdump64 -c 80 -s 5 process.exe # CPU threshold trigger
procdump64 -t process.exe # Terminate after dump

psexec64.description: Execute processes remotely and locally with different user credentials and system privileges
psexec64.usage:
PsExec64 \\remote-pc cmd # Run command on remote system
PsExec64 -s cmd # Run as SYSTEM account
PsExec64 -i -s cmd # Interactive SYSTEM session
PsExec64 -u user -p pass \\pc cmd # With credentials

psfile64.description: Display files opened remotely via file shares and optionally close them
psfile64.usage:
psfile64 # Show all remote file opens
psfile64 \\remote-pc # Files on specific system
psfile64 -c 123 # Close file by ID
psfile64 file.txt # Show opens for specific file

psgetsid64.description: Display Security Identifier (SID) for user accounts on local or remote systems
psgetsid64.usage:
PsGetsid64 username # Get SID for user
PsGetsid64 \\remote-pc username # Remote user SID
PsGetsid64 S-1-5-21-123... # Convert SID to username

psinfo64.description: Display system information including hardware, OS version, and installed software
psinfo64.usage:
psinfo64 # Local system info
psinfo64 \\remote-pc # Remote system info
psinfo64 -h # Hardware details
psinfo64 -s # Installed software
psinfo64 -d # Disk space

pskill64.description: Kill processes by name or process ID on local or remote systems
pskill64.usage:
pskill64 notepad # Kill by process name
pskill64 1234 # Kill by PID
pskill64 \\remote-pc notepad # Kill on remote system
pskill64 -t 1234 # Kill process tree

pslist64.description: Display detailed information about running processes including CPU usage and memory statistics
pslist64.usage:
PsList64 # List all processes
PsList64 -m # Include memory usage
PsList64 -t # Show process tree
PsList64 -x # Show threads and handles
PsList64 notepad # Info for specific process

psloggedon64.description: Display locally and remotely logged on users with logon times and session information
psloggedon64.usage:
PsLoggedon64 # Show local logons
PsLoggedon64 \\remote-pc # Remote system logons
PsLoggedon64 -l # Local logons only
PsLoggedon64 -x # Don't show logon times

psping64.description: Enhanced ping utility with TCP ping, latency testing, and bandwidth measurement capabilities
psping64.usage:
psping64 hostname # ICMP ping
psping64 -t hostname:80 # TCP ping to port
psping64 -l 1024 -n 100 hostname # Latency test
psping64 -b -l 1k -n 1000 hostname:80 # Bandwidth test

regdelnull64.description: Delete registry keys containing null characters that cannot be deleted with standard tools
regdelnull64.usage:
RegDelNull64 HKLM\Software\BadKey # Delete key with null chars
RegDelNull64 -s HKLM\Software # Scan for null-char keys
RegDelNull64 -r HKLM\Software\BadKey # Recurse subdirectories

streams64.description: Display and delete alternate data streams (ADS) attached to NTFS files
streams64.usage:
streams64 file.txt # Show streams for file
streams64 -s /dir # Recurse directory
streams64 -d file.txt:stream # Delete specific stream
streams64 -nobanner /path # Quiet output

strings64.description: Extract printable strings from binary files, executables, and memory dumps for analysis
strings64.usage:
strings64 file.exe # Extract strings from executable
strings64 -n 10 file.bin # Minimum string length 10
strings64 -u file.exe # Unicode strings
strings64 -o file.exe # Show offsets

sync64.description: Flush file system buffers to ensure data is written to disk immediately
sync64.usage:
sync64 # Flush all file system buffers
sync64 C: # Flush specific drive
sync64 -e # Show elapsed time
sync64 -r # Force registry flush

volumeid64.description: Display or change the volume serial number of FAT and NTFS drives
volumeid64.usage:
VolumeId64 C: # Show volume ID for C:
VolumeId64 C: 1234-ABCD # Set new volume ID
VolumeId64 # Show all volume IDs

whois64.description: Perform WHOIS lookups to retrieve domain registration and IP address information
whois64.usage:
whois64 example.com # Domain WHOIS lookup
whois64 192.168.1.1 # IP address lookup
whois64 -v example.com # Verbose output
whois64 -h server example.com # Use specific WHOIS server
